critique: The render has the right botanical/dandelion-like source imagery on black, but it reads as a field of intact dandelion heads with stems rather than loose seeds blowing outward. At t1 the frame is very sparse; by t4 it abruptly becomes crowded with large, upright full flowers distributed across the entire image. The temporal change is primarily accumulation/population, not a coherent wind-driven plume or wide dispersal from a seed source. The near-comp-sized emitter makes particles appear everywhere instead of traveling outward from a localized origin.

suggestions.why: Localize the X emitter extent so particles originate from a seed source instead of appearing across the full frame.
Localize the Y emitter extent to establish a readable blowing origin and plume.
Make the sprite instances much smaller so they read closer to airborne seed material than large intact dandelion heads.
Broaden the directional spread after localizing the emitter, producing the requested wide blown-out distribution rather than a uniform full-frame field.
